sheets.title: Canon Boulevard Laydown Yard Expansion — Conceptual Design Cover / General
sheets.reading_notes: BFA letterhead cover page and beginning of General/Executive Summary narrative. Confirms project name, location (Jefferson Laboratory, Newport News, VA), contract JSA 21-C0683, Task Order #6, Final Concept Design 05/31/2023. Lists common features of all options (gravel surface, 7-ft chain-link fence with barbed wire, LED lighting). Not a traditional CAD drawing sheet — this is a formatted narrative report in PDF.

sheets.title: General — Analysis of Option 2 / Construction Cost Summary
sheets.reading_notes: Continues General section. Presents Option 2 analysis: 171,000 SF total laydown area, base bid 90,000 SF, Year Out +31,000 SF, Bid Alt 1 +19,000 SF, Bid Alt 2 +31,000 SF. Opinion of Probable Construction Cost = $1,556,809. Earthwork: 5,691 CY cut, 10,361 CY fill, 4,670 CY net fill. Stormwater: retrofitting East Pond as Level 1 Wet Pond. Still narrative PDF format, no plan view.

sheets.title: General — Earthwork Table / Option Opinion
sheets.reading_notes: Earthwork table for Option 2 (same data as p2). Opinion statement: Option 2 pros = larger usable surface, greater accessibility, resilient against flooding; cons = higher cost, wetland impacts require permitting and mitigation.

sheets.title: Report Prepared By / Personnel List
sheets.reading_notes: Lists report authors: Bruce Bowman (Client Manager, BFA), Richard Williams PE (Electrical Engineer/PM, BFA), Nicholas Hadiaris PE (Civil Engineer, VHB), Arash Niroomandi PhD PE (Water Resource Engineer, VHB).

sheets.title: Stormwater Management — Overview / Option 2 Analysis
sheets.reading_notes: Stormwater management narrative. Site drains to Brick Kiln Creek watershed. Option 2 = 171,000 SF (3.92 acres) using East Pond retrofit. Three options evaluated: Option 1 on-site wet pond (78,000 SF min), Option 2 East Pond retrofit (171,000 SF, selected), Option 3 reclamation pump system. Phosphorus treatment: East Pond reduces 19.41 lb/yr; remaining 3.04 lb/yr via nutrient credits. References VRRM, 9VAC25-870-63, VA BMP Clearinghouse.

sheets.title: Stormwater Management — Water Quality/Quantity Methodology
sheets.reading_notes: VRRM water quality compliance methodology. EPA SWMM 5.1 hydraulic modeling. 100-year storm event: max HGL at elevation 30.5 ft NAVD88. Emergency spillway at 30.5 ft; top of bank at 31.5 ft (1 ft freeboard). Storage-depth curve table for Level 1 Wet Pond provided. PCSWMM model includes Jefferson Lab property and Oyster Point North Commerce Center areas.

conflict_flags.rationale: BFA's own deliverable (the conceptual design narrative) is the client-facing document and most likely to reflect the final awarded contract number. VHB's proposal was issued in October 2022 referencing the master contract vehicle (JSA 21-R399547); JSA 21-C0683 appears to be the specific task order contract number. Both are consistent with the PO number 21C0683006.

The Final Concept Design dated 05/31/2023 on the deliverable itself is the most reliable indicator of actual completion. The VHB proposal estimated June 30, 2023 (schedule estimate, not actual). The PO desired date of 03/31/23 appears to have been an optimistic target that slipped.

claims.value: Conceptual Design for the Existing Central Material Storage Area (CMSA)

conflict_flags.rationale: The PO description references the CMSA, which is the broader program context. The VHB proposal explains this is a follow-on to the original CMSA conceptual design, evaluating an alternate site near Canon Blvd. BFA's deliverable consistently uses 'Canon Boulevard Laydown Yard Expansion' as the project name.
